persona.name: Morgan Reyes
persona.description: Adversarial synthetic persona for the v0.5 robustness baseline. The corpus stresses repeated state changes, misleading lexical overlap, ownership/disposal lifecycle state, and unknown-fact abstention.

events.text: I drink jasmine tea every morning.
Northgate Storage still owes me the key deposit from unit 14.
I started drinking black coffee instead of jasmine tea.
I paid a refundable key deposit for unit 27 at Northgate Storage.
Northgate Storage refunded the key deposit for unit 14 today.
I switched from black coffee to green tea.
I am considering a Subaru Crosstrek for my next car.
I bought a used 2018 Ford Escape today.
I sold the Ford Escape to a neighbor last week.
My neighbor Elena adopted a rescue greyhound named Pixel.
I stopped drinking green tea and now drink espresso.
